Hi Hoeschec, on EA i think it's just a matter of time about price coming back down, because there is a pole with unfilled orders just below your Diamond, then they will be taken, but it means the SL would be however at risk.... Your trade short is very close to the Origin of the Move ( the LL in your chart is a spike in the OTM ), then i think i would have preferred a Long opportunity when the price came down along that pole, instead of a Short.

many thanks all the best
posts.fa:
سلام Hoeschec، روی EA فکر می‌کنم فقط مسئلهٔ زمان است که قیمت برگردد پایین، چون یک پایه با سفارش‌های پرنشده درست زیر الماس تو هست، بعد آن‌ها گرفته می‌شوند، اما یعنی SL به هر حال در ریسک خواهد بود… معاملهٔ فروش تو خیلی نزدیک مبدأ حرکت است (LL در چارت تو یک جهش در OTM است)، بعد فکر می‌کنم ترجیح می‌دادم فرصت خرید می‌بود وقتی قیمت در امتداد آن پایه پایین می‌آمد، به‌جای فروش.

posts.t:
Just practicing QM's and decision points.

I zoomed in on this area (EUR-AUD) 1 Min chart and noticed a QM area that overlaps with a DP & origin of an engulf. I wonder how reliable these levels are for a bounce when price returns? It seems like the overlapping area (the space overlapping the gray and yellow rectangle) would be an excellent convergence of orders & good place for a TT.

I'm going to look for more examples of these...
